items.headline: Claude Fable 5.2 launches for all users, with a faster, clearer model
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 on November 9. It is up to 30% faster than Fable 5.1 and blocks far fewer legitimate requests (about 55% fewer in early testing). Pro plans and standard Team seats get it for up to 50% of weekly usage limits.
items.why_it_matters: If you pay for Claude Pro or Team, you can try the newest top-tier model on real work this week. Anthropic still suggests Opus 5.5 for most everyday tasks and Fable for the big, open-ended jobs.

opportunity.action_note: Switch to Fable 5.2 in Claude on one real project this week and compare it to Opus 5.5, since the Pro-plan usage allowance is limited.
opportunity.angle: I put Claude's brand-new Fable 5.2 through a real small-business task

items.headline: Anthropic starts its IPO roadshow
items.summary: On November 10 Anthropic began the roadshow, the investor tour that comes before a company sells stock to the public for the first time. It follows the S-1 filing (the official paperwork for going public) from October 26.
items.why_it_matters: It signals Anthropic is a long-term company, which matters if your business leans on Claude. Nothing changes in your plan today.
